gaps.explanation: p5 governmental funds statement: the Total Governmental Funds column nets the intra-governmental transfers ('Transfers in (out)' Total '-') and prints only Transfer from CRA 35,542 (= JSON transfers_in). detail[] records the fund columns gross, as printed: General Fund Transfers in 114,669 (p10, = p5 General Fund column) and Sales Tax Fund Transfers from CRA 35,542 (p12); the matching outs are Sales Tax (109,533) and Other Funds/CDBG (5,136) = 114,669. Schedule 150,211 - statement 35,542 = 114,669 = the gross General Fund transfer in. Nothing to add or remove.

p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints Electric, Water, Sewer and Sanitation Fund columns; no business-type schedule exists and none is in detail[]. JSON business-type receipts = operating revenues (Consumers, Miscellaneous) + Interest income + Grant revenue. Electric 764,459 + 8,454 + 331 = 773,244; Water 221,892 + 8,538 + 38 + 107,265 = 337,733; Sewer 148,815 + 1,587 + 10 = 150,412; Sanitation 91,833 + 1,587 = 93,420. Sum 1,354,809 = statement total = gap.
